critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/routes/shop.py:283 — Out-of-stock check uses `item.get('stock') is not None and item['stock'] <= 0`; OK but stock decrement in approve_request (line 361) uses snapshot stock not live stock — race condition possible if multiple approvals overlap (extremely low impact for DM-gated flow).
/app/backend/routes/shop.py:341 — Approve refuses when already approved/denied with status 400 + dynamic detail; good idempotency.

/app/backend/routes/shop.py:290 — Ownership check `pc_meta.get('user_id') and pc_meta['user_id'] != user['id']` correctly bypasses for admin; characters lacking `user_id` in metadata are implicitly public to any requester — flag for future hardening but matches the documented DM-driven model.
/app/frontend/src/pages/Shop.jsx:78 — 8s polling for requests + PC gold; fine for the small DM table but consider stopping the timer when tab is hidden via visibilitychange to save battery.
/app/frontend/src/pages/Shop.jsx:284 — Background image always loads gradient overlay even if URL is broken (graceful degradation confirmed working).
/app/frontend/src/pages/AdminShop.jsx:144,307 — Uses window.confirm() for destructive actions; works but inconsistent with the app's themed modals elsewhere.
